en: A black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square bordered by Baroque and Renaissance-style townhouses with arcades on the ground floor. The building in the foreground has three arches with signs above them and dormer windows in the tiled roof. Farther along the row are ornate facades with stucco decoration and a church tower with an onion dome and clock rising behind them. A few pedestrians stand or walk in the square, which is mostly empty.
